title: Healing of a Demon-Possessed Boy
description: The day after the transfiguration on the mountain, Jesus meets a large crowd. A father cries out and asks Jesus to look at his only son, who is tormented by a spirit that seizes and convulses him. The disciples have been unable to drive it out, and Jesus rebukes the unbelieving and perverse generation. He commands the unclean spirit, heals the boy, and gives him back to his father. While the people marvel at God's greatness, Jesus predicts that the Son of Man will be handed over into human hands, but the disciples do not understand.
